project.name: PQC-APS :: Classical Baseline
project.description:
Classical (pre-quantum) cryptography implementation used as the Phase 1 baseline. Includes X25519 key exchange, RSA-2048 signatures, AES-256-GCM encryption, HKDF-SHA256 key derivation, and the full classical handshake + secure channel.
IMPORTANT — this module is intentionally vulnerable in four documented ways (VULN-1 through VULN-4). See VULNERABILITIES.md at the project root. Phase 2 will attack these weaknesses; Phase 4 will fix them.
